faq.q: What is the origin of Afnan?
faq.a: Afnan is associated with Arabic. Afnān, plural of فَنَن ('branch, twig'), occurring in Sūrat al-Raḥmān.
Yes — the underlying form أفنان is Arabic.
Afnan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

Afnan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. أفنان occurs in the Qur'an (Sūrat al-Raḥmān 55:48) as a common noun meaning 'branches'; it is not a Qur'anic proper name
